'''Mos Le'Harmless''' (pronounced ''MOH-s lee-HARM-less'') is the quaint, [[Pirate (Mos Le'Harmless)|pirate-run]] free port that can be visited after completion of the [[Cabin Fever]] [[Quests|quest]]. The island has a few attractions, such as the [[Trouble Brewing]] [[minigames|minigame]] and the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]], where [[cave horror]]s are found.

Players must be carrying the ''[[Book o' Piracy]]'' in their [[inventory]] to understand what the inhabitants are saying and interact with them. Otherwise, the pirates and shopkeepers will respond with a fixed script of incomprehensible pirate slang. The book, however, is not necessary to use the bank on the island.

==Transportation==
You must complete [[Cabin Fever]] to access the island.

* Talk to [[Bill Teach]] on the eastern boat in [[Port Phasmatys]]. (Fastest way there is the [[ectophial]].)
* Use the [[Minigame Teleport]] to Trouble Brewing (requires completion of the quest and 40 [[Cooking]]).
* Teleport to [[Harmony Island]] and talk to [[Brother Tranquility]].
* [[Mos le'harmless teleport]] scrolls (brings you to the north gate).
* [[Charter ship]] (can be used once the quest is complete).
* [[Rum (red)|Red]] or [[Rum (blue)|blue]] rum to teleport to Trouble Brewing (costs 20 [[pieces of eight]] each).

==Notable features==
* [[Trouble Brewing]] — A [[minigame]] that involves two teams making rum.
* [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]] — A dangerous cave filled with cave horrors. (A [[ Light sources|light source]] is required.)
* [[Dodgy Mike's Second Hand Clothing]] — Sells pirate gear. (Trading requires carrying the ''[[Book o' Piracy]]''.)
* [[Two Feet Charley's Fish Shop]] — Sells raw fish. (Trading requires carrying the ''[[Book o' Piracy]]''.)
* Access to the [[Mos Le'Harmless bank|bank]] in the port.
* Access to [[Harmony Island]] via [[Brother Tranquility]] near the docks.
* [[Slayer task]] [[monster]]s:
** [[Jungle horror]]
** [[Cave horror]] (requires 58 [[Slayer]])
** [[Albino bat]] (counts toward [[bat]] assignment)
* [[Agility]] [[Shortcuts|shortcut]] — [[Stepping stone (Mos Le'Harmless)|stepping stone]] that requires 60 Agility to use; allows for faster access to the Mos Le'Harmless Cave.
* [[Teak tree|Teak]]/[[Mahogany tree|Mahogany]] trees (accessible from the exit at the end of the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave|cave]]).

==Charter ship==
The [[Charter ship|charter system]] includes a dock in Mos Le'Harmless as well as several other locations. Since travel to and from Mos Le'Harmless requires [[Cabin Fever]] to be completed, the cost of all trips is already reduced by 50%; wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] can reduce the cost by an additional 50%.

==Trivia==
* Despite the name sounding like "mostly harmless" the island is in fact very dangerous due to the large quantities of jungle horrors and the dark cave with deadly monsters lurking within.
* The name "Mos Le'Harmless" alludes to the ''{{wp|The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy|Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy}}'' series by Douglas Adams, in which the guide's entry on planet Earth is simply "Mostly Harmless".{{CiteVideo|author=Old School RuneScape|title=Jagex Mods Pronounce RuneScape Words|url=https://youtu.be/kFM6RSCzPgI?si=iIjCysgTR1oBs7Y7&t=96|timestamp=01:36 - 01:42|date=5 June 2016|site=YouTube|notes=|name=}}
